project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite single-page app (frontend of a Flask backend monorepo). Tailwind CSS 3.4 for styling. TanStack Query for data fetching, react-router-dom v6 for routing, Recharts for charts, framer-motion for animations, Three.js (R3F) for 3D viewers.
build_system: Vite + tsc. Build script is `tsc && vite build` (npm run build). No workspace/monorepo on the frontend side. IMPORTANT: Tailwind JIT silently skips unknown class names (it does NOT error), so a build passing does NOT guarantee a class token exists — only TypeScript errors and real syntax errors fail the build. New colour tokens MUST be added to tailwind.config.js (FEAT-001) BEFORE any page uses them.
test_framework: None on the frontend. There is no vitest/jest/playwright configured. Verification is the production build (`npm run build` = tsc type-check + vite bundle). The backend has pytest but it is out of scope and must NOT be touched.
verification_instructions: From the frontend directory run `npm run build`. It must exit 0 and emit the dist/ bundle. Fix ONLY TypeScript/build errors introduced by the changes; do not fix pre-existing unrelated errors unless they block the build. Because Tailwind never errors on unknown classes, also visually diff className strings against the token names defined in tailwind.config.js to avoid referencing a token that doesn't exist.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The build emits dist/ which is gitignored and should NOT be committed. No other generated/snapshot files are checked in.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Backend at ../backend must NOT be modified. Do not run `npm run dev` during the workflow. Do not add npm packages. Node_modules already installed. Paths with backslashes are fine in PowerShell; use forward slashes in tool paths.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exist. README is the only guide. Constraints from the task brief are authoritative: only modify files under frontend/; never touch the backend; never change TS interfaces, API URLs, auth, routing, or business logic; never add packages; never hardcode data; never remove JSX elements or props — change className strings only (and occasionally wrap with a styled div).
key_patterns: Styling is 100% inline Tailwind utility classes on JSX elements — there are NO shared CSS component classes and NO styled-components; every visual change is a className edit. Colour values are mostly hardcoded literals (e.g. bg-[#FFC800], text-[#5B6068], bg-slate-50) not tokens, so the redesign replaces literals with the new tokens. Recurring building blocks: KPI/stat cards (`bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl`), data tables (header `bg-slate-50 text-[#5B6068]`, body `text-slate-700 divide-slate-200`, row hover `hover:bg-slate-50`/`hover:bg-blue-50`), filter tabs (active `bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm`, inactive `text-[#5B6068]`), primary buttons (`bg-[#FFC800] hover:bg-[#e6b400] text-black`), status badges (light-tinted e.g. `bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700`), and modals (`bg-slate-900/60` backdrop + `bg-white` card). Shared layout components (AppLayout, Sidebar, Navbar) wrap all authenticated routes via AppLayout + Outlet.

directory_structure: frontend/src/components/layout/ = AppLayout (Outlet wrapper + fleet-workspace guard), Navbar (top bar), Sidebar (nav). frontend/src/components/tyre/ = TyreCard (shared, used by TyresPage) + TyreHealthy/Warning/Critical (SVG images, leave alone). frontend/src/components/3d/ + inspection/ = Three.js + 2D viewers (leave internals). frontend/src/pages/fleet/ = 16 fleet pages (the main work). frontend/src/pages/public/ = Landing, Login, Register. frontend/src/pages/admin/ = AdminDashboard, AdminMap, OEMFleetVault. frontend/src/pages/driver/ = DriverPortal. frontend/src/store/authStore.ts = Zustand auth store (no styling). frontend/src/services/ = api.ts + offlineQueue.ts (no styling).
